rehome.back.about: After the reinstall: open the Rehome folder that survived the wipe, tick what to bring back, and each folder goes to the path it came from. Nothing here reinstalls a program; that is install.ps1 in the same folder, run by hand, before this step.
rehome.back.done: back: {0} files verified, {1} left as they were.
rehome.back.exists: already there, newest {0}. Pick what wins below.
rehome.back.extra.byhand: shown, not written: open it and put back what still applies.
rehome.back.extra.fonts: installs each font for this user through the Fonts folder.
rehome.back.extra.gitconfig: copied to the profile; one already there is kept as .gitconfig.old.
rehome.back.extra.powershellprofile: copied to Documents; files already there are left alone.
rehome.back.extra.wifi: one netsh call per network, with what each said.
rehome.back.fonts: {0} fonts handed to the Fonts folder.
rehome.back.go.hint: Each folder is copied to where it came from and verified. The Rehome copy stays: it is the only one that survived the wipe.
rehome.back.headline: Packed {0} on {1} for {2}: {3} folders, {4}, {5} extras.
rehome.back.hint: A folder the installer has already made is shown side by side; a config from an old version under a fresh install can be worse than none, so look before choosing.
rehome.back.incomplete: not every file came across on the way out; see the manifest
rehome.back.pick.hint: The folder with rehome-manifest.json in it, on the drive that was not wiped.
rehome.conflict.both: Keep both: theirs becomes .old, mine goes in
rehome.conflict.mine: Keep mine: only add what is missing
rehome.conflict.theirs: Keep theirs: overwrite with what was carried
rehome.description: Packs the machine up before a clean Windows install: what is installed and how to get it back, what the wipe takes and where to keep it, and the way back afterwards.
rehome.destination.gone: That folder is not there any more.
rehome.destination.hint: A drive that is not being wiped, or an external one. A folder named Rehome and the date goes under it.
rehome.destination.tight: The folders ticked come to {0}; the drive has {1} free.
rehome.destination.wiped: That is on a drive being wiped, which makes it no destination at all.
rehome.dialog.manifest: The Rehome folder from before the wipe
rehome.drives.hint: The Windows drive, unless the installer is told to take more. Tick every drive it will format; the destination cannot be one of them.
rehome.empty: Press Scan. The uninstall registry, the package managers, the folders the wipe would take, the not-folders and the keys are all read; nothing is written until Pack.
rehome.extra.environment.note: Written to environment.txt, PATH aside. Not restored automatically.
rehome.extra.fonts.note: The per-user fonts folder. Windows' own fonts are not carried; they come with Windows.
rehome.extra.gitconfig.note: Name, email, aliases. Copied as a file.
rehome.extra.hosts.note: Copied as a file. Putting it back needs an elevated prompt, so it is shown rather than written.
rehome.extra.path.note: User and machine, one entry per line, to path.txt. Read it on the new install and add back what still exists.
rehome.extra.wifi.note: netsh wlan export, with the passwords in clear: that is the point of it, and why the wifi folder is named for what it is.
rehome.extras.about: The things that go with the drive and are not folders, or are too small and too easily forgotten to leave in the list. They land under extras\ in the Rehome folder.
rehome.cloud.pull.hint: OneDrive keeps some files only in the cloud. Off, the copy skips them and says how many. On, opening each makes OneDrive fetch it first, which takes as long as the download; OneDrive has to be running, and a file it cannot fetch is listed as failed.
rehome.folders.about: Program Files and Windows are not on the list and cannot be added: an installed program copied across is a folder that does not run, and the program list is how it comes back.
rehome.folders.headline: {0} folders, {1}; {2} ticked, {3}.
rehome.folders.stale: The drives changed. Scan again to list the folders on the drives now ticked.
rehome.how.launcher: {0} · sign in and it comes back
rehome.keys.about: What the key finders do, done once and written to keys.txt beside the manifest. Read once, kept nowhere: an export, not a vault. The Windows key goes in with slmgr /ipk or Settings > Activation; every other key goes into its program's own dialog.
rehome.filter: Search programs, folders, the way back…
rehome.toget.hint: The short list, by hand: to-get.md to read and to-get.ps1 to run, with the winget, Chocolatey or Scoop line where a manager knows the program and a search line where none does. Written into the folder packed this session, else straight into the destination; Pack it up writes it too.
rehome.toget.tick.hint: Put it on the to-get list: the programs you actually want back, apart from the full list.
rehome.note.survives: on {0}, which is not being wiped; it survives.
rehome.error.toget: The to-get list could not be written: {0}
rehome.note.browser.keeps: {0}: profile copies whole, saved logins, accounts and local mail included. Close it before packing; on the way back, put it back before the first start, or choose keep theirs.
rehome.note.browser.loses: {0}: bookmarks and history yes, passwords no; they are locked to this Windows account. Sign in to sync before the wipe.
rehome.note.onedrive: in the cloud too. Cloud-only files are skipped unless the option above pulls them down.
rehome.note.otherdrive: on a drive ticked as wiped.
rehome.note.root: made at the root of the Windows drive.
rehome.note.ssh: keys: the Rehome folder will hold them too.
rehome.pack.hint: The lists and keys.txt are written first, then each ticked folder is copied and verified, then the extras. Nothing is removed from here: the wipe is the delete.
rehome.programs.elsewhere: {0} more sit on drives not being wiped and keep their files.
rehome.programs.onlywiped.hint: Off shows the ones installed on drives not ticked as wiped too, marked. Their files stay; only the registry entry goes. Folders and extras only ever come from the ticked drives.
rehome.programs.headline: {0} programs: {1} winget, {2} Chocolatey, {3} Scoop, {4} through a game launcher, {5} by hand.
rehome.progress.folders: Listing the folders the wipe takes…
rehome.status.brought.failed: {0} brought back, {1} failed; the rows say which.
rehome.status.cancelled: Stopped. What was found before stands.
rehome.status.pack.cancelled: Stopped after {0} folders. The manifest at {1} says what arrived.
rehome.status.packed.failed: {0} folders, {1}, packed at {2}; {3} did not copy cleanly, see the manifest and the log.
rehome.status.start: Not scanned yet. Press Scan; nothing is written until Pack.
rehome.steps.hint: The first four are before the wipe and share one Pack. The last is after it.
rehome.title: Rehome
rehome.records.to-get: wrote the list of what to get back
